{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ul'Husk Ocean''' was a small [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. [[Ulan Bight]], the deepest location on the planet, was located in the southern portion of the Ul'Husk Ocean.<ref name="SotE">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>
